ns2:course.label: Actuarial Research
ns2:course.description: Guided research on actuarial topics. 1 to 4 undergraduate hours. 1 to 4 graduate hours. Approved for Letter and S/U grading. May be repeated in separate terms. Prerequisite: ASRM 390 or consent of instructor.
